Regulatory Affairs Managers develop global registration and compliance strategies, manage regulatory teams, coordinate submissions and review communications across markets, and control launch timing and regulatory risk. They are key managers connecting products with regulators.

paragraphs: In the morning, review U.S. and European regulatory calendars. Hold a team meeting to assign work and revise strategy, then video-call the U.S. team about the submission checklist. At midday, review critical documents and verify indications and labeling. In the afternoon, handle unexpected deficiencies and reschedule work. Late at night, sign the final submission and maintain pace across time zones.

In one sentence: plan the product's path to market, lead the team, and explain the case clearly to regulators. Duties include strategy, team management, submission scheduling, agency communication, pace control, and quality oversight. The work engages regulations, people, and markets.
